FieldApp._comment: Where a person is sent after resetting a password they asked for from the Field App. Looked up by the Admin Portal host the request arrived on; BaseUrl is the local-development fallback. Never taken from the reset link.

Jwt._comment: Key/Issuer/Audience are sourced from Azure Key Vault in staging/production (Phase 8) — see JwtOptions.cs. Left empty here deliberately; appsettings.Development.json has the dev-only placeholder.
